name: UI: roleplay card, thought
description: A copy of the roleplay card with the speech bubbles and the party strip taken away, and only a thinking indicator over the innkeeper: pulsing dots in a rounded box with a trail of dots for a tail, no words. The backdrop is render 18 with the painted-out patches filled in by the Codex image tool (innkeeper-table-plate-clean.webp). The indicator is anchored to the region named innkeeper in that picture's SAM 3.1 layout (media locate), with its own numbers as the fallback; playground set sam=true|false shows the layout.

phone.goal: Find a guide to the Ember Roads
narration: The innkeeper wipes a mug and waits for your answer.
